description: This file contains code for benchmarking and experimenting with multi-head attention modules, including a custom CompositeMHA class, experiment configurations, and benchmarking functions. It is specific to a transformer model's self-attention mechanism, utilizing PyTorch and CUDA sdp kernel.

classes.name: ExperimentConfig
classes.description: Holds configuration parameters for an experiment, such as batch size, number of heads, sequence length, etc.

classes.name: ExperimentResults
classes.description: Stores timing results for different attention module runs.

classes.name: Experiment
classes.description: Combines a configuration and its corresponding results.

classes.name: CompositeMHA
classes.description: Custom multi-head attention module that combines linear projections and scaled dot-product attention.

methods.name: get_entries
methods.description: Returns list of configuration or result entries.

methods.name: get_entry_names
methods.description: Returns list of entry names for configuration or results.

methods.name: build_composite_mha_from_nn_mha
methods.description: Constructs a CompositeMHA instance from a PyTorch nn.MultiheadAttention module.

methods.name: generate_rand_batch
methods.description: Generates a random batch tensor with optional padding.

methods.name: benchmark_torch_function_in_microseconds
methods.description: Benchmarks a function's execution time in microseconds.

methods.name: assert_close_tensors
methods.description: Checks if two tensors are approximately equal.

methods.name: run_single_experiment
methods.description: Runs an experiment with a given configuration, returning timing results.

methods.name: generate_experiments
methods.description: Generates a list of experiment configurations based on parameter grids.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function to run experiments, print results, and optionally save CSV output.
